device.description: quadruple 8-bit voltage-output DAC with TMS320/SPI serial interface (FS frame sync), LDAC, hardware and software power down, programmable settling time

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A input (shift-register target, A1 A0 = 00); power-on zero (p.12)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B input (shift-register target, A1 A0 = 01); power-on zero (p.12)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C input (shift-register target, A1 A0 = 10); power-on zero (p.12)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D input (shift-register target, A1 A0 = 11); power-on zero (p.12)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A latch; follows the input while LDAC is low

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B latch; follows the input while LDAC is low

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C latch; follows the input while LDAC is low

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D latch; follows the input while LDAC is low

registers.name: CTRLA
registers.note: internal: PWR (D13) and SPD (D12) of the last word written to DAC A; power-on zero

registers.name: CTRLB
registers.note: internal: PWR (D13) and SPD (D12) of the last word written to DAC B; power-on zero

registers.name: CTRLC
registers.note: internal: PWR (D13) and SPD (D12) of the last word written to DAC C; power-on zero

registers.name: CTRLD
registers.note: internal: PWR (D13) and SPD (D12) of the last word written to DAC D; power-on zero

commands.name: Write DAC A
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D4 = new DAC value, D3-D0 = 0 (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC B
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D4 = new DAC value, D3-D0 = 0 (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC C
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D4 = new DAC value, D3-D0 = 0 (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC D
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D4 = new DAC value, D3-D0 = 0 (p.13-14)

protocol.note: FS falling starts a 16-bit frame (CS must be low); bits sampled on SCLK falling edges, SCLK high at FS falling (Figure 1, p.7) -> mode 2; after 16 bits (or FS rising) the word is moved to the selected DAC

ldac.note: LDAC high: no DAC output updates; the outputs are only updated while LDAC is low (p.3)

device.note: tlv5627.pdf (SLAS232A) p.1 (D/PW pinout, description), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD/DVDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, SCLK 20 MHz), p.6 (digital input timing), p.7 (Figure 1), p.12 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.13 (data format A1 A0 PWR SPD + 8 data bits + 0000), p.14 (A1 A0 DAC select)

pages: (SLAS232A) p.1 (D/PW pinout, description), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD/DVDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, SCLK 20 MHz), p.6 (digital input timing), p.7 (Figure 1), p.12 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.13 (data format A1 A0 PWR SPD + 8 data bits + 0000), p.14 (A1 A0 DAC select)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs (x2 buffer), reference inputs REFINAB / REFINCD, analog supply AVDD
CS is not modeled: FS is the frame pin of the model (CS must be held low, as in the three-wire connection of Figure 16); in four-wire use CS high would ignore FS frames
FS rising before 16 bits ends a frame early and moves a partial word; the model drops short frames
PD pin (active low, powers down all DACs and output stages, overriding the PWR bits) and the PWR / SPD bits: analog only; PWR / SPD stored per DAC, PD not modeled
variants: tlv5627.pdf covers only the TLV5627 (C and I grades); D and PW share one pinout. The TLV5614 is the 12-bit quad with the same pinout (separate datasheet).
